title: An invitation to the enumerative geometry of degenerations
summary: This expository article is an introduction to logarithmic Gromov--Witten (GW) theory. We discuss how to study the GW theory of a smooth projective variety via simple normal crossings degenerations. We survey several approaches to constructing well-behaved, virtually smooth moduli spaces of stable maps to such degenerations. Each irreducible component of the special fiber of a degeneration determines a pair consisting of a variety and a normal crossings divisor, and these pairs carry their own logarithmic GW theory.
